description: Create a whole location tree (buildings, floors, rooms, storage places) in one call — same contract as scaffold_categories: WITHOUT confirm you get a dry-run plan and nothing is written (existing same-name locations at the same position are reused, never duplicated); after your user's ONE explicit OK, retry the SAME call with confirm: true and the tree commits atomically. parentName references another entry in the same call (include existing parents — they are reused). Expand spoken ranges ("rooms 201 to 210") into explicit entries yourself. Requires the manager role.

confirm.description: Pass true ONLY after your user explicitly confirmed the previewed plan

locations.description: The whole tree as a flat list, parents referenced by name

parentName.description: Name of the parent location — another entry in this call (omit for top level)

name: scaffold_locations

instruction.description: Mirror the plan back and get ONE confirmation — preview mode

preview.description: True = dry run, NOTHING was written; retry with confirm: true

title: Scaffold location tree
